source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; Flora of North America / World Flora Online, US Forest Service FEIS, 2017 Lee County Texas voucher flora
name_concept_summary: POWO/WCVP independently accepts E. intermedia and E. lugens. Historical E. lugens var. major maps to E. intermedia, E. lugens var. villosa maps to E. polytricha, and invalid E. lugens Rupr. maps to E. capillaris. Authorship and rank prevent mistaken duplicate cards or specimen relabeling.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; original county nativity/range decisions untouched
specimen_identity: HOLD — no individual photograph or voucher independently identified
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no specimen-level hybrid ancestry inferred
install_decision: Retain existing canonical species; synonym mapping is research-only; no installations or card, image, lesson, county, Pages, or schedule changes

decisions.subject: Eragrostis intermedia Hitchc. (1933)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species; canonical authority Hitchc. correct
decisions.detail: No taxonomic rename or new card.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens Nees (1829)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain separately accepted Poaceae species; canonical authority Nees correct
decisions.detail: Do not collapse with E. intermedia.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis intermedia var. appressa Withersp. (1977 publ. 1978)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic variety to E. intermedia Hitchc.
decisions.detail: Not an accepted separate variety under current POWO.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens var. major Vasey (1894)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic variety to E. intermedia Hitchc., NOT E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Cross-species rank trap. Retain original historical combination as an alias with full rank and author.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis pilosa var. lugens (Nees) Griseb. (1879)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic synonym to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Author and parenthetical basionym authority are diagnostic.

decisions.subject: Poa lugens (Nees) Kunth (1833)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic synonym to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Historical genus combination.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis flaccida Lindm. (1900)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic synonym to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Accepted destination follows current POWO/WCVP.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens var. flaccida (Lindm.) Hack. (1911)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Do not treat as an accepted infraspecific taxon.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens subsp. flaccida (Lindm.) Hack. (1911)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Rank-specific name retained as synonym evidence.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens var. glabrata Döll (1878)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Current heterotypic synonym.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens var. glabrescens Döll (1878)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Do not conflate spelling with var. glabrata; distinct historical names.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens f. pallida Hack. (1911)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical form to E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Form rank is not separately accepted.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis pilosa var. lugens Kuntze (1898)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as illegitimate later homonym, synonym of E. lugens Nees
decisions.detail: Not the same author-qualified name as Griseb.'s 1879 homotypic variety.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens var. villosa Döll (1878)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to separately accepted E. polytricha Nees
decisions.detail: Critical cross-species boundary: not a synonym of E. lugens under current POWO.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis lugens Rupr. (1842), not validly published
decisions.proposed_decision: Record under E. capillaris (L.) Nees as an invalidly published historical name
decisions.detail: Not equivalent to accepted E. lugens Nees (1829); authorship is essential.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis polytricha Nees (1829)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted species identity, no automatic merge with E. lugens
decisions.detail: Modern accepted destination of var. villosa.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis capillaris (L.) Nees (1829)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted species identity, no automatic merge with E. lugens
decisions.detail: Modern accepted destination of invalidly published E. lugens Rupr.

decisions.subject: Bulk-map all E. lugens infraspecific combinations to E. lugens Nees
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic parent-binomial mapping; var. major belongs to E. intermedia, var. villosa to E. polytricha
decisions.detail: Inspect rank, author and accepted-name destination per record.

decisions.subject: Treat Eragrostis lugens Nees and E. lugens Rupr. as one authorless name
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject author-insensitive name merge
decisions.detail: Rupr. 1842 not validly published and currently placed under E. capillaris.

decisions.subject: Merge E. intermedia, E. lugens, E. polytricha and E. capillaris as one learner species
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject duplicate-concept collapse; all four are separately accepted species
decisions.detail: Synonyms under one historical parent binomial do not make modern accepted taxa synonymous.

decisions.subject: Existing E. intermedia and E. lugens photo/specimen determinations
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve specimen-level identity uncertainty; no photos relabelled
decisions.detail: Published Lee County flora describes E. lugens within a taxonomically difficult group; name review cannot authenticate images or vouchers.

decisions.subject: Individual hybrid, introgressed or cultivated ancestry
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer hybrid parentage or provenance from nomenclature or field photographs
decisions.detail: No plant-level hybrid evidence examined; no named-hybrid assertion made.

decisions.subject: Historical labels 'Eragrostis lugens' without author/rank/voucher
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep source record unresolved until full historical combination and specimen context are recovered
decisions.detail: Authorless label can hide E. lugens Nees, invalid Rupr. usage or cross-species historical varieties.
